prompts:
Create realistic, production-quality UI designs with clear hierarchy, strong typography, intentional imagery, and purposeful spacing. This is an actual responsive personal family/photo/health archive website in Turkish at kira.uylas.net, not a breeder sales website. Kira is a provisional name; owner has not chosen which of three merle puppies yet. All three are candidates, never identify one as confirmed Kira. The breed is Miniature American Shepherd. The source website basileas-minis.com is CONTENT reference only, not a design/style reference; reinvent the design independently. User wants all photos, family relations, breeder-written descriptions, health results, and dated history to be easy to browse. Focus this frame on the specified main experience, not a feature inventory. Keep further profile details accessible via navigation instead of crowding.
Canvas target: 2048 x 1536 landscape design board with one cohesive design shown at two responsive breakpoints: a 1440px wide desktop web screen on the left and the SAME site's 390 x 844 mobile viewport on the right, both scaled proportionately to fit with spacious gutters. A single design per image. No device bezel, browser chrome, OS status bar, notch or phone shadow. Crisp flat screenshots, readable 14–16px body type before scaling, generous whitespace; do not stretch, warp or awkwardly clip. Max two typefaces. Use typography, grouping, spacing and light separators rather than card-in-card layouts or unnecessary shadows. No invented metrics, vaccinations, birthdays, puppy gender, or tests.
Dates anchored to today 27 Ekim 2026; puppy originals archived 25 Ekim 2026. If shown use source capture date 27 Ekim 2026, not a birth date.
Reference assets: first three attached images are reference CONTACT SHEETS, each pairing actual puppy on LEFT and its corresponding generated adult on RIGHT. Sheet 1 copper face, sheet 2 broad white blaze, sheet 3 small white muzzle mark. Use the photos inside them as individual UI images, NOT the whole sheet. Preserve puppy identities. AI adults must be labelled 'AI tahmini' or 'Temsili yetişkin'. Last two attached images are original website screenshots for Billie and Zane including their actual photos and grandparents. They are factual and photo references only, do not copy old site's style. Exact family facts where relevant: mother Billie, formal Basileas Journey Continues, blue merle, 39 cm. Father Zane, formal Basileas Lil Bit N Zane, black/copper/white, blue eyes, 40 cm. Billie HD A/A, NAD +/− taşıyıcı. Zane HD B/C, NAD +/+; do NOT mark every test healthy/clear or infer the puppies' genetics. Eyes clear is a health exam, not eye color. Never promise future eye color.
Use real attached photographs in the UI with respectful crops and exact identities, not illustrated substitute dogs. AI images stay visibly distinct from actual source photography. Only product UI and small external presentation title, no explanatory design annotations.
Direction name: 'Hatıra Defteri'. Premium quiet editorial family album: warm ivory #F5F1E8, deep forest green #263F35, natural copper accents. Elegant literary serif headings paired with clean sans labels. Not rustic scrapbook, no paper texture, stickers, paws or childish illustration.
Desktop: thin top masthead 'kira.' on left, elegant nav 'Adaylar  Ailesi  Sağlık  Arşiv'. Small domain and an understated 'İsim geçici' note. Main intro left aligned, large 'Birlikte yazacağımız hikâye.' with short subline 'Üç küçük aday. Bir aile. Saklamak istediğimiz her detay.' Small 'Henüz seçilmedi' pill. Main action 'Aileyi keşfet ↗'.
Main content hero is three equal well-proportioned photographic columns, each showing the actual puppy with a discreet numeric '01', '02', '03' and 'Bakır yüzlü', 'Beyaz alın çizgili', 'Küçük beyaz benekli'. Under each puppy a much smaller landscape thumbnail of its matching AI adult, clear 'AI tahmini • Yetişkin görünümü' label. Names are descriptors not official puppy names. This 3-column grouping has no heavy boxed cards, pictures have subtle small radius. Originals are most prominent.
Below a thin divider a compact spacious family section 'Hikâyesinin başladığı yer' with real Billie and Zane landscape photos side by side, caption 'Billie · Anne' / 'Zane · Baba'; each next to 2 exact result lines 'HD A/A · NAD +/− taşıyıcı' and 'HD B/C · NAD +/+'. Link 'Soy ağacına bak →'. Footer provenance 'Basileas Minis • 27 Ekim 2026 tarihinde kaydedildi'.
Mobile: same ivory green style and masthead, title reflows, brief note, 3-candidate segmented selector with 01 active. Show large actual first puppy, small corresponding AI preview clearly labelled below, and next family heading entering natural lower scroll area. Mobile not three tiny photos side by side. Clean, calm, intimate and timeless. No extra widgets.

Main desktop has broad genealogy canvas left 70%, selected profile inspector right 30%, separated by thin line. All 3 remain peers, none confirmed chosen. Use genuine puppy photos from LEFT of first 3 reference sheets. No duplicate dogs or incorrect links. Compact 'Diğer kardeşler →' text link below and 'Yetişkinlik tahminlerini gör →' optional secondary action. No health results on small tree nodes.

Bottom navigation 'Aile / Yavrular / Arşiv'. Extremely polished, useful family knowledge archive.
